_help: Labels print in the order of these groups, top to bottom (move a group up or down to change the order). A SKU goes in the FIRST group, from the top, that has a matching pattern; * matches anything, so '* dip 2cm' matches '4 dip 2cm'. Inside a group: pattern order, then by number. A group with match ['*'] collects every SKU not listed anywhere else, wherever you put it; mark it warn:true to be told about those SKUs on each run so you can add them. An order with items from several groups goes with its LATEST group.
